prompts.A: A student measured the mean initial reaction rate (micromoles per minute) of an amylase-catalyzed reaction at three levels of pH, as shown in the table. Describe how the initial reaction rate changes across the three levels of pH, and identify the level with the greatest initial reaction rate. Use values from the table to support your description.
prompts.B: Calculate the percent change in the initial reaction rate from pH 4 to pH 7. Show your work.
prompts.C: Using the ±2SE values in the table, determine whether the difference between the mean initial reaction rate at pH 7 and at pH 10 is statistically supported. Justify your answer with the ±2SE ranges.
prompts.D: Explain why the initial reaction rate is lower at pH 4 than at pH 7. Use data from the table as evidence and connect your explanation to what you know about enzymes.
